'''Jawa's Market''' was a marketplace in [[Daiyu City]] on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]]. It was advertised by [[Aurebesh]] signs of various [[color]]s. It shared its name with the [[Jawa]] [[species]] from [[Tatooine]].<ref name="EpIV">{{Film|IV}}</ref>
